source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"The total white blood cell count alone, without factoring in the percentage of neutrophils present","B":"The platelet count on its own, considered separately from any measure related to the white blood cells","C":"The total white blood cell count multiplied by the percentage of neutrophils (segmented plus band forms)","D":"The client's hemoglobin and hematocrit readings, evaluated apart from any white blood cell measure"}}
source_row.rationale: ANC is calculated using the total white blood cell count multiplied by the percentage of neutrophils (segmented plus band forms), providing a specific measure of the client's neutrophil-mediated infection-fighting capacity, more clinically relevant than total WBC count alone in this context.
source_row.source_name: ONS — ANC Calculation and Clinical Significance
